subject: 🐋 The easiest way to start
preview: Five minutes and one question. Any answer is fine.
h1_bold: Your first Reflect takes about five minutes.

blocks.alt: Illustration: an orca tail rising over waves in front of a coral sun

blocks.text: Starting is usually the hardest part. So here's the smallest possible version: open MindSync, tap Reflect, and answer one question. How was today, really?

items: Orca listens and asks a follow-up question or two.
You can reread the conversation later, or delete it if you'd rather not keep it.
If something comes up that you want to bring to therapy, add it to your Therapy Agenda.

blocks.alt: Two MindSync screens: a Reflect conversation with Orca, and the What Orca remembers page

blocks.text: Not the right time? That's fine. MindSync will be here when you are.

footer_promise: We promise to only send you mental health-related tips & updates.

footer_image.alt: Illustration: a lighthouse on a cliff, a sailboat and a coral sun

crisis_line: MindSync isn't a crisis service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US, or find a local helpline at findahelpline.com.
